expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: A circular loading spinner is still displayed in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' banner even though the image behind it has fully rendered, making the card look stuck/broken.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is cut off at the right edge and its title is truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, so it reads as broken text rather than an intentional peek.
Restaurant hero images are very dark and blurry with strong bokeh, making the food barely identifiable and reducing contrast for the white overlay badges (e.g. '20–30 min', '€0 delivery').
The favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
The second 'Popular right now' card is clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible name, rating or delivery info, so it looks unfinished rather than scrollable.

Icon-only controls (notification bell with red dot, heart favourite buttons) have no visible text label; contrast of the grey placeholder text in the search field and the '€0.90 delivery' subtitles is also low.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes a loading spinner remaining over an image after the content has fully rendered.
